description: This file defines a module for managing a Node.js service within a gateway framework. It provides functions for setting environment variables, installing, uninstalling, stopping, restarting, and checking if the service is loaded, all with environment configurations specific to the Node service. It also exports a function to resolve and return a configured GatewayService object.

methods.description: Adds Node service specific environment variables to a given environment object.

methods.description: Resolves and returns a GatewayService object configured for the Node.js service, with methods for stage, install, uninstall, stop, restart, isLoaded, readCommand, and readRuntime.
